title: Mean value point for a cubic · Set 3
statement:
Find the MVT point for $x^3$ on $[0,[$a]]$.

[__________]{a}
hints: State the continuity and differentiability of polynomials.
Match it to $3c^2$ in the open interval.
solution: The slope is $[$a]^2$. Solve $3c^2=[$a]^2$ and take the positive root $[$a]/\sqrt3$.

feedback.message: Match it to $3c^2$ in the open interval.
